data.translation: Die Dachwalze hat einen hölzernen Bügel; den stecken wir mit den enden in je ein Loch zu beiden Seiten hinein, befestigen einen Strick daran, streuen ein wenig feinen Häcksel hin und walzen so die Dächer.

data.turoyo: Amṭele kulav, maləfle i ḥurmayḏe bu kulavawo, ġalabe mašiġole b maye šaḥine, b ṣafono, malifole bu kulavawo w mandrole hawxa šawʕo garrat, xəd ḥa soyəm u kulav.
data.translation: Da holte er einen Filz, wickelte seine Frau in den Filz, wusch sie ordentlich mit heißem Wasser und Seife, wickelte sie in den Filz und rollte sie so! (der erzähl er zeigt es) sieben Mal herum, so, wie wenn man Filzdecken macht,

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; rolling a wrapped person is explicitly compared to felt preparation, motivating a broader gloss.

after: walzen, rollen (Dach; auch wie bei der Filzbereitung);
rationale: 58/278 explicitly compares rolling a wrapped person to making felt; remove the implication that only roofs can be rolled, without creating a separate participant sense.

summary: The existing combined Infectum and Infectum-wa box contains one non-wa example and one Joseph quotation with two wa tokens. Counts are separated by example, not by number of repeated tokens.

The roof-rolling activity takes zero-marked roof NPs or -nne patient indexing, and b- marks the roller instrument. A possible denominal association with manduriye remains the inherited etymological question, not an established derivation.
mandinanne beside mandrínanne is retained exactly; it is not independently established as a dialectal sound rule. No new idiomatic phrase is required.
Is r-less mandinanne at 94/24 a spoken contraction or textual omission?
Does mandrole in 58/278 designate rolling as in felt-making, or a more specific compacting operation?
The inherited stem note II: mxamele/mxaməl appears unrelated to ndr and may have been carried in with the Joseph quotation. Should it be moved to the relevant entry?
A wrapped person can be rolled as felt is worked. The same rolling operation extends beyond roofs; the gloss is widened without a separate numbered sense.
